## Composition

Principal public BeeUI exports used by this screen: [`Button`](/docs/components/button/), [`Card`](/docs/components/card/), [`Chip`](/docs/components/chip/), [`ChipGroup`](/docs/components/chip/), [`HStack`](/docs/components/stack/), [`Link`](/docs/components/link/), [`Text`](/docs/components/text/), [`VStack`](/docs/components/stack/).

The pattern is a composition recipe rather than a new framework layer. Follow the linked component contracts for state, provider, platform and accessibility details.

## State and callback contract

The screen is controlled through `InterestsOnboardingScreenProps`. User intent crosses the application boundary through `onContinue`, `onSelectionChange`, `onSkip`; fetching, routing, persistence and side effects remain application-owned.

```tsx
export type InterestsOnboardingScreenProps = {
  currentStep?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  onContinue: () => void;
  onSelectionChange: (value: string[]) => void;
  onSkip?: () => void;
  options?: readonly InterestOption[];
  selectedValues: string[];
  totalSteps?: number;
};
```

Common product states such as loading, success, empty, error, permission-like recovery, filtering/search/selection or pagination are represented only where the actual screen source exposes them. The pattern docs do not invent backend states that the fixture does not render.

## Application ownership boundary

**Intentionally excluded:** Topic catalog fetching and persistence of selected interests.

BeeUI does not take ownership of app routing, authentication/business rules, APIs/data fetching, persistence, form/state frameworks, chart frameworks or backend logic merely because a pattern visually composes those product concepts.

## Source ownership

`InterestsOnboardingScreen` is **Showcase source you copy**, not a package export: it is not shipped from any `@beemvp/beeui-*` package, and the Registry CLI (`pnpm beeui list` / `pnpm beeui add`) does not carry pattern screens. Copy [`apps/showcase/patterns/auth/screens/interests-onboarding-screen.tsx`](https://github.com/beobungbu/BeeUI/blob/main/apps/showcase/patterns/auth/screens/interests-onboarding-screen.tsx) into your app and adapt it directly. Only the individual BeeUI components it composes (linked above) are available for source ownership through the repository-local Registry workflow; before public CLI publication, use [CLI & source ownership](/docs/guides/cli-source-ownership/) from a BeeUI checkout rather than a public `npx` command.
